fields.Name: T45 - Data Explorer Paginate Members
fields.Description: Verifies that the Members grid pagination control advances to the next page and shows a different page of records.

InputDefinition.goal: IMPORTANT: To open the 'Members' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box — type 'Members' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Members' (individual member people, ~2000 records; NOT 'Board Members', 'Campaign Members', 'Member Follows', 'Memberships', 'Membership Types', 'Chapter Memberships', or 'Committee Memberships'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Open the 'Members' entity grid (~2000 records across many pages). Use the grid's pagination control at the bottom to advance to the next page (page 2); verify a different page of member rows is shown. Do not repeatedly toggle the same control. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Members entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
The pagination control has advanced past the first page (page indicator shows page 2 or higher)
A different set of member rows is displayed than the initial page
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
